item.title: The Blastozoic Era Co-Sponsors Immortal Christian Rock Festival - The Blastozoic Era
item.description: Christian metal and hard rock legends are playing at the first annual Immortal Christian Rock Festival in Ohio in September: Barren Cross, Whitecross, (Classic) Petra (which means Greg X. Get tickets and more information here: https://www.bmieventcenter.com/christian-rock-festival/#ARTIST
